preDeployCommand: bundle exec rake db:migrate && bundle exec rails runner 'InstallationConfig.find_or_initialize_by(name: "DEPLOYMENT_ENV").tap{|c| c.value="self-hosted"; c.save!}; InstallationConfig.find_or_initialize_by(name: "INSTALLATION_PRICING_PLAN").tap{|c| c.value="enterprise"; c.save!}; InstallationConfig.find_or_initialize_by(name: "INSTALLATION_PRICING_PLAN_QUANTITY").tap{|c| c.value=10000; c.save!}; ENV["CAPTAIN_OPEN_AI_API_KEY"].to_s.empty? || InstallationConfig.find_or_initialize_by(name: "CAPTAIN_OPEN_AI_API_KEY").tap{|c| c.value=ENV["CAPTAIN_OPEN_AI_API_KEY"]; c.save!}; GlobalConfig.clear_cache'
